apparatus.basis: Standard Manichaean Kephalaia heading-formula ⲛ̄ⲕⲉⲫⲁⲗⲁⲓⲟⲛ 'another chapter'; only ⲛ̄ is missing.
Completion of ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧⲟⲩ 'in/from them' across line break (line 1 ends ⲛ̄ϩ, line 2 begins ⲧⲟⲩ).
Completion of ⲛ̄ϩⲏⲧⲟⲩ from preceding line.
Completion of ⲡⲓⲥⲁϣϩ ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲓⲧ 'the seven paths' across line break (line 2 ends ⲡⲓⲥⲁϣ, line 3 begins ⲧ for ⲙⲁⲓⲧ). Cf. line 3 'paths which are outside.'
Completion of ⲙⲁⲓⲧ 'paths' (Lyc. for ⲙⲟⲉⲓⲧ); standard Manichaean term for the seven cosmic paths.
Completion of ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲛⲟⲩϫⲉ 'where they have cast' across line break.
Completion of ⲛⲟⲩϫⲉ 'cast' from preceding line.
Completion of ⲉⲓⲥⲧⲉ 'behold,' standard Coptic interjection.
Completion of relative ⲉⲧⲉϣⲁⲥⲉⲓ 'in which she habitually comes.'
Editor's restoration of relative ⲉⲧ-ⲥⲱⲧϥ̄ 'which refines' (qualitative of ⲥⲱⲧⲡ̄/ⲥⲱⲧϥ̄ 'choose, refine, smelt'), describing the prison's refining function.
Completion of ⲡⲱⲛϩ̄ 'the Life,' a standard Manichaean cosmic principle (the captive Life-substance refined in the cosmic prison).
Editor's restoration of ⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ ⲁⲛⲓⲥⲉϫⲉ 'heard these words,' standard Kephalaia narrative formula introducing disciples' response.
Editor's restoration; the parallel form recurs at line 18 (ⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩⲓⲉⲧⲛ̄). Standard apostolic-revelatory verb.

notes.decision: Translated 'drawn back' per accumulated vocabulary entry ⲥⲱⲝⲧ̄ ⲁⲡⲁϩⲟⲩ 'draw back / regress'. The subjects appear to be the archons, who have retreated behind from the action of the cosmic refinement.
Read ⲡⲁϩⲟⲩ here as a verbal use ('fall back, retreat to') rather than the standard adverbial 'behind'; the conjunctive future ⲉⲩϣⲁⲛ- requires a verb. Confidence moderate.

Tentatively translated 'snatchings-forth.' The ⲱⲗ-ⲁⲃⲁⲗ family covers 'carry/lift forth'; cf. accumulated ⲁⲗⲱⲭϩ̅ 'extract, snatch out' and ⲟ̄ⲁⲗⲟ̄ⲗ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'draw out, lift forth.' The plural noun would name characteristic archonic operations of seizing light from souls. Confidence low; the lexeme is unattested in our corpus.

Read as Lycopolitan reflex of ϩⲱⲣⲡ̄ 'fall, sink' with directional ⲁⲣⲁⲩ 'upon them.' The agent ('they fall upon them') is taken as continuing from the archonic subject of the previous clause; alternatively the angels of line 10 may be the assailants. Translation 'fall upon them' fits the punitive cosmological flow culminating in the archons' imprisonment.

Translated 'prison' here rather than 'Zone/Girdle.' The accumulated glossary lists ⲧϩⲱⲛⲏ as 'prison/fastness (tentative)' or possibly = ⲧⲍⲱⲛⲏ 'the cosmic Zone.' The immediate context (archons cast into a structure 'which is outside,' guarded by angels under the Virgin of Light's authority) decisively favors the prison-of-archons reading consistent with Manichaean cosmography of the bound dark powers in the zodiacal Zone.

Restored as ⲥⲱⲧϥ̄ qualitative 'refines, smelts, filters' (cf. ⲥⲱⲧⲡ̄/ⲥⲱⲧϥ̄ in metallurgical sense). The cosmic prison/Zone is described as the locus where the captive Life is refined upward through the celestial vessels — standard Manichaean cosmography.

Tentatively read as Lycopolitan variant of ⲣⲏⲧⲉ 'manner, fashion' (cf. ⲡⲣⲏⲧⲉ in glossary). With ⲛ̄- 'of' it would yield 'the manner of [exposition/narration] of all the apocalypses.' Lexeme uncertain; could alternatively be an unidentified noun.

Parsed as ⲛⲙ̄- ('and/with') + ⲡⲉⲧ-ϩⲏⲧ ('that-which-is-within' or 'the foremost') + ⲧⲏⲣⲟⲩ ('all'). Translated 'with all that is within' — the inward/hidden contents of the apostle's revelation that have been disclosed to the disciples.
